description.text:
Golden Energy (辉金能量) is a Simplified Chinese special pack made to keep the Sun & Moon series going after the game moved on to Sword & Shield. Its three-card packs came only inside gift boxes released on 9 September 2023: every pack held one holo basic Energy with a gold border and one random holo Sun & Moon Trainer, and its third card was another Trainer or, with luck, a random holo Pokémon. The Golden Energy Gift Box held one pack with Storming Emergence, Shining Synergy, Battle Elite and Striking Competition packs and a Rayquaza coin in a random color; four Golden Energy Advanced Gift Boxes, one for each of Tapu Koko, Tapu Lele, Tapu Bulu and Tapu Fini, held two packs with more of the Sun & Moon packs, a display frame and a deck box.

Pokémon sold 40,000 Advanced Gift Boxes on its Tmall store, 10,000 of each, by lottery: members first had to answer at least one of three quiz questions to enter, and the draw was notarised. Its 36 Trainers and nine gold Energy are numbered out of 45; nine rainbow Pokémon-GX, among them the four Tapus, Charizard GX, Rayquaza GX and three TAG TEAMs, are numbered past it, up to 54.
